title: Richard Miethe joins Avro project with John Frost and the CIA
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Richard Miethe joins Avro project with John Frost and the CIA, about 1950s at Canada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: evidence that Richard Mita who was from SCOD works and commar project that was going on in Canada which was British aircraft and John Frost and in partnership with the American CIA.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there is evidence that a man named Richard Miethe, who he says came from a European industrial works, joined an aircraft project in Canada in the 1950s. According to Michels, the project was run by Avro, a British aircraft maker, with an engineer named John Frost, in partnership with the CIA, the American spy agency. He tells it because it would tie disc-shaped craft research to a real, secret government programme.
